response.enhanced_information: Glycoproteins are characterized by a protein backbone linked to carbohydrates via glycosidic bonds, with the protein part serving as the core structure. The length of sugar residues, while variable, is not a defining feature of glycoproteins. Options A (Protein linked with glycosidic bond) and B (Core protein) are correct, reflecting essential aspects of glycoprotein structure.
